title: Oracle no Houseki: Jewels of the Oracle
overview:
The Oracle guides you into rooms built to surround a well, a world like an ancient tomb.

Jewels of the Oracle is a collection of 24 puzzles hidden in the chambers of an ancient city. Move from room to room and work out each challenge, from logic tests to strategy games, often without being told the rules. When you are stuck, the Oracle offers a short, cryptic hint, but solving the puzzle is left to you.

- 1 player
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
- Memory backup

井戸を取り囲むように造られた部屋、古代の墓のような世界へオラクルが導きます。
